Three distinct functions ride on that motor count, and the practical benefit is sustained intensity: single-motor toys fade when modes stack, while this one holds its output through the combined settings. The rose head keeps the silky-touch surface the category is known for.

USB magnetic charging handles power without a port, and full waterproofing covers bath use and thorough washing alike. For a four-motor build, the maintenance routine stays two steps — rinse and dry.

USB magnetic charging keeps the routine short, and the waterproof shell rinses clean under the tap — no seams, no port, no crevices to work at. As an everyday object, it is about as low-fuss as the category manages.

The elastic stretch also absorbs pressure. Where a rigid toy transmits every push directly, the flexible stem gives a few millimeters before the mechanism resumes, which makes long sessions noticeably easier on the wrist doing the steering.

@@IMG@@

Life waterproofing covers the everyday exposures — shower spray, rinse washing — and the rechargeable battery eliminates the battery drawer entirely. Between five tongue modes and twelve thrust frequencies, the pairing grid runs wide enough to stay interesting.
